# codigate_agent (Data Source)

Looks up an agent by id or by name. The token is never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "codigate_agent" "home" {
  name = "home-lab"
}

output "home_lab_connected" {
  value = data.codigate_agent.home.connected
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Agent id (agt_...). Set id or name.
- `name` (String) Agent name. Must match exactly one agent.

### Read-Only

- `connected` (Boolean) Whether the agent is connected now.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `last_seen_at` (String) Last connection (RFC 3339).
- `version` (String) Agent version, once it has connected.
